name: Shinseki no Otokonoko o Hikitotta Hanashi
original_name: 親戚の男の子を引き取った話
source:
"The other day, I picked up a relative boy. The child seems to have been abused by his parents, and not only his body but also his heart is very deeply injured. I don't know how to do it, even if I want to heal it. So please. If you watched this video, please give me some advice."

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28184]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“前几天，我接了一个亲戚的男孩。这孩子好像被父母虐待了，不仅身体，连内心都受到了很深的伤害。我不知道该怎么办，即使我想治愈它。所以拜托，如果你看了这个视频，请给我一些建议。”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28184]Freem![/url]]
